content: Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. YOUR IMPACT Compliance at Mollie is a competitive advantage — and you'll be the one building it. As a Senior Regulatory Compliance Officer, you'll be at the heart of how we scale responsibly across Europe, turning complex regulatory requirements into practical, automated solutions that actually work for the business. You'll own the frameworks, lead the conversations, and make sure compliance moves at the same pace we do. You'll also lead and develop a team of junior and mid-level compliance officers — coaching them, reviewing their work, and helping them grow. Your expertise across AML/CFT, sanctions, and regulatory advisory will set the standard for how the team operates and how compliance is embedded across Mollie. This is a role where your work has real reach. The frameworks you build, the policies you shape, and the culture you foster will directly support over 350,000 businesses growing with less friction and more freedom. What you'll bring - Around 5+ years of experience in Treasury, ALM or balance sheet risk management, ideally within a bank, though experience in a fintech, PSP or consultancy building similar frameworks is also relevant. - Solid working knowledge of liquidity risk (LCR/NSFR, ILAAP) and/or interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB/CSRBB). You don't need to be deep in both, but you understand how they connect to the balance sheet as a whole. - Comfort building models and frameworks from a blank page. You're not looking for a well-worn playbook, you're excited to write the first one. - Strong quantitative and Excel/financial modelling skills, with the discipline to document your logic clearly enough that someone else, including a regulator, can follow it. - The ability to explain complex balance sheet risk topics clearly to non-specialists, and the confidence to defend your recommendations to senior stakeholders. - Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of this work that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgment and design. Let's build together. YOUR IMPACT We're looking for a Senior Internal Auditor who is as sharp as they are bold. Someone who doesn't just run audits, but challenges how audits get done, helping us safeguard Mollie's assets and keep our operations sound as we scale. As Mollie continues to grow, including our ambitions in the payments and banking space, this function plays a direct role in maintaining the standards of control, compliance, and risk management a fast moving fintech needs. You'll join a small team of auditors who chose depth over breadth: fewer topics, deeper dives, real impact. As a senior member, you'll take full ownership of audits from start to finish, bringing a fresh perspective and genuine enthusiasm for using AI to make audit work sharper and faster. WHAT YOU'LL SHIP - Lead and execute internal audits across the whole company, including finance, operations, technology, and compliance. - Develop and implement audit plans, including risk assessments, using innovative tools and techniques such as AI. - Conduct in-depth reviews of processes and controls to identify risks and areas for improvement. - Prepare clear, concise, and insightful audit reports with findings, recommendations, and follow-up actions. - Collaborate with management to implement corrective actions and ensure risks are effectively mitigated. - Contribute to and help evolve the team's AI powered audit platform and tooling. - Stay current on relevant auditing standards, regulations, and best practices, and continuously explore new audit methodolog

Let's build together. YOUR IMPACT Mollie's Risk team is growing, and this role sits at the center of that growth. You'll work closely with product teams as they build and enhance offerings like card issuing, bank accounts, instant transactions, and new payment methods, making sure every new product holds up against regulations without adding risk for our customers. You'll also screen new tools and vendors entering the organisation, owning the security angle (think authorization and authentication) while working alongside Compliance on every new product. As a senior member of a small team, you'll bring technical depth and help colleagues earlier in their risk careers build theirs too, especially as AI becomes a bigger part of how Mollie operates. This isn't a role for checklist followers. You'll work independently, without rigid frameworks, and help shape how security risk is handled as Mollie's footprint keeps expanding. If you’re ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you. Your impact The Infrastructure Governance team within the developer enablement domain sits at the heart of Mollie's infrastructure. We own and maintain Terraform as our IaC system and play a crucial role in ensuring our infrastructure is highly reliable and compliant with industry standards like PCI-DSS, sitting directly in the critical payment path and communication layer between external works and our platform. We also manage critical components that support all of Mollie’s infrastructure. That means what we build and maintain isn't just technical infrastructure; it's the foundation that keeps payments moving safely and reliably for hundreds of thousands of businesses across Europe. As a Platform Engineer on this team, you'll be working on Mollie's Cloud Platform (MCP), our flavour of GCP, enabling product teams to create real value. Your work will span critical cloud infrastructure, automation, observability, and system reliability. You'll collaborate closely with system and software engineers, and interface with teams across compute, database engineering, edge, and networking. The impact is immediate and tangible: the systems you build and maintain keep Mollie's payments running. This is a role for someone who cares about quality for engineers and non-engineers alike and who brings a genuine passion for automation, distributed systems, and getting things right at scale.
